_note: Every HV Reset feature: only for Beta users, for everyone (Beta and public), or coming next. The admin page (Beta features tab) reads this file. Update it with each change; add a picture in features/.

features.name: Plan my day
features.desc: Make a day plan in a few taps: tasks, times, breaks and meals.

features.name: Add a task
features.desc: Add a task for now, today, tomorrow or any date.

features.name: Full day view
features.desc: See and edit every task of the day in one list.

features.name: Month calendar
features.desc: See the month at a glance. Tap a day to open it.

features.name: Session targets
features.desc: Before starting, write what you'll finish. Checked at Done (hit, partly, missed).

features.name: Proof photo
features.desc: Attach a photo or link to a finished target, and rate how focused you were.

features.name: Focus level: Easy, Deep, Extreme
features.desc: Pick how strict HV Reset is with you. Deep asks “Still on it?” every 20 min and notes time away; Extreme checks in every 10 min, reminds you 20 s after you leave, allows one pause and needs proof at Done.

features.name: Timer alerts
features.desc: Notifications at halfway, 5 minutes left and time's up.

features.name: Mini timer
features.desc: A small timer window that stays on top (Chrome and Edge on a computer).

features.name: Timer in the tab name
features.desc: Time left shows in the browser tab title.

features.name: Focus timer
features.desc: One task at a time with a clear countdown. Start, pause, done.

features.name: Running late? Shift the day
features.desc: Start late and move the rest of the day by the same time, or keep your times.

features.name: Calm focus mode
features.desc: Buttons fade away while you work and come back when you move the mouse.

features.name: Targets on the dashboard
features.desc: Targets hit, sessions and proof shown on the Overview.

features.name: Customize Overview
features.desc: Drag sections into your own order and hide the ones you don't need.

features.name: Score first on the Overview
features.desc: Big score card with the parts that make it up, at the top.

features.name: How your score is made
features.desc: See the points each part adds to your score, the biggest gain, and choose how much each part counts (Off, Normal, Important, Top).

features.name: Default dashboard period
features.desc: Pick the period the dashboard opens on, the same on every device.

features.name: Dashboard
features.desc: Your score, time worked, punctuality, trends, reports and insights.

features.name: HV AI starts with a target
features.desc: Ask HV AI to start a focus session with a target in one line.

features.name: HV AI
features.desc: Plan or change your day by typing or talking, in Hindi, English or Hinglish.

features.name: Stay on the same screen after refresh
features.desc: Refresh, Back and shared links keep you on the dashboard, Full day or Beta Hub.

features.name: Beta Hub
features.desc: Tester pass, what's new, known issues, roadmap and credits.

features.name: Bug reports with screenshot
features.desc: Report a bug with a marked-up screenshot and device info.

features.name: Shake to report
features.desc: Shake the phone (or Ctrl+Shift+B) to report a bug.

features.name: Ideas, votes, polls and survey
features.desc: Suggest ideas, vote, answer one-tap polls and the weekly survey.

features.name: Points and leaderboard
features.desc: Points for reports and ideas, monthly top testers, Founding Tester badge.

features.name: Your data export
features.desc: Download your sessions as CSV or JSON, or share a read-only link.

features.name: Dev panel
features.desc: Event log and version info for testers (off by default).

features.name: Stats tab
features.desc: Testers see how HV Reset is growing: visitors, sign-ins and tasks done. Shown only when the owner turns it on in Team & access.
